titles.title: Lavender Hill with Trees

description: In this minimalist, semiabstract work, a deep purple hill arches over a cluster of trees with purple trunks and blue and green foliage. Green bushes dot the area around the trees, and a blue sky curves over the scene.
title: Lavender Hill with Trees
